evals.prompt: Add a blog post for the Hackathon Playbook about how non-coders can choose a hackathon project idea. The target reader is a lawyer, doctor, or consultant using AI tools for the first time. Primary keyword: hackathon project ideas for non coders. Keep it practical and include internal links.
evals.expected_output: A complete blog post plan or post object that follows the rich content block system, targets the keyword, and includes internal links plus SEO details.
expectations: The output includes a slug, title, 150-160 character description, reading time, keywords, and section plan or post object.
The output uses at least three rich content block types and includes at least one link-card.
The output avoids unattributed quote blocks or includes complete quote attribution.

evals.prompt: I want a new SEO article called 'Hackathon Demo Script: How to Present in 3 Minutes'. Make it useful for beginners preparing for judging. Include a checklist and a sample click path.
evals.expected_output: A beginner-friendly SEO blog article structure using blocks, with demo-specific guidance, a checklist, and related internal links.
expectations: The output targets a clear search keyword in the slug and title.
The output includes a checklist block and a step-list or pro-con block.
The output includes an SEO checklist or verification summary.
